title: Vios client status
description: One file per client at clients/<slug>/status.json. Written by the Vios skills at the end of every step, read by the /vios front door and by scripts/clients.py. The deliverables map mirrors the client's ClickUp '<Client> — Deliverables' list one to one.

doc.description: Claude Doc link or repo path

pdf.description: repo path of the client deliverables sheet

history.description: earlier versions, moved here when a new version is written: {version, status, doc, pdf, date}

baseline.description: The month-0 measurement (templates/client/data/baseline.md), made by vios-engagement-setup step 7 before any deliverable; the monthly report compares against it.

status.description: not trading = venue not yet open: no page is written, the first full month of trading becomes the baseline (setup step 7); the report's Baseline column reads 'no baseline yet: venue opened <date>'

date.description: measurement date YYYY-MM-DD; the period is the three full months before it

kpis.description: The outcome KPIs the proposal promises to move (vios-proposal step 3 'What we aim to move'); baseline from data/baseline-YYYY-MM.md; latest written by vios-monthly-report every month; the harvest's case lesson is this table's story.

name.description: covers per month, average check, Google rating, reach, labour %, bookings by own channel ...

baseline.description: number from the baseline page, or 'measured in week 1' ('measured in month 1 after opening' for a venue not yet trading) / 'to confirm'

target.description: the 90-day (or stated) target, absolute or '+10 %', or 'set at baseline'; short, the card prints it

target_note.description: the sentence behind a short target, when one is needed

how_measured.description: source and n rule, e.g. 'Memento P&L, monthly covers'

attribution.description: guardrails › Shared numbers: we claim contribution, never causation, unless an offer-day lift supports it

stages.description: The four method stages ('1 Brand' … '4 Training') plus 'Engagement', the engagement-level row: its deliverables hold the ClickUp ids of the tasks no stage owns, keyed Intake · Proposal vN · Setup · Baseline · Harvest · Report YYYY-MM (docs/skill-contract.md § 3.3). The card prints it on its own line, after the stages. A marketing-only client may add 'Marketing'. Stage status: 'signed' at the sign-off meeting; a deliverable is 'approved'.

audit.description: Stage 4 only: the thirty-day register audit (a scored mystery visit on the house frame) and the certification state; written by vios-training-programme Move 7 and by the audit itself.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the thirty-day audit; planned date until done

sheet.description: repo path of the mystery-visit sheet used

certified.description: people certified of people on the floor, e.g. '9 of 11'

deliverables.description: key = deliverable name as the practice ships it
